subject: One more thing
body:
The site looks great. Two changes:

- Swap Diavola for Quattro Formaggi at 15, and make Espresso 3.5.
- Add a table booking form (name, email, date, time, party size 1-8), only during opening hours. Each booking should email the guest a confirmation with a cancel link.

params.dishes: Margherita 12, Quattro Formaggi 15, Lasagne 15, Tiramisu 7, Espresso 3.5
